pages.title: v0.66.9.5-RC2: ROM Sprite/Vehicle Atlas
pages.summary: Direct-ROM sprite-map exploration and evidence-linked vehicle-family research built from the Windows-qualified v0.66.9.5-RC1.1 baseline.

blocks.title: Candidate provenance
blocks.text: RC2 is built directly from exact Windows-qualified v0.66.9.5-RC1.1 SHA-256 556aaee447fd0ebd616001139ae6f26572bad327325d48c105da6388905c44f1. RC2 remains a candidate until its own exact archive passes chqdev.bat qualify --fresh.

The ROM Sprite / Vehicle Atlas decodes b52-38.34 spritemaps directly against OBJ-A and OBJ-B graphics without requiring a map to become active in live sprite RAM. It supports obj-a, obj-b64, obj-b32 and all-format interpretation, raw-pen geometry, selected-palette previews, per-map provenance and labelled contact sheets/browser output.

Runs003-007 proved police-beacon Force ON/OFF is causal but presentation is staged: descriptor generation changes in the 0x1027xx list before the later D00000 live sprite list and framebuffer. Regression therefore verifies eventual live presentation after the authentic pipeline delay rather than requiring a one-frame response.

items: Confirmed player_car.body additions: maps530 and 536.
Confirmed player_car.shadow additions: maps598 and 600.
Confirmed target_car addition: map20.
Confirmed police_beacon additions: maps519, 540 and 617 plus palette78.
Run012 map450-620 visual families remain ROM-visual candidates unless runtime/causal evidence promotes them.
sprites.list and sprite.inspect expose sourceMap/sourcePalette separately from effectiveMap/effectivePalette and override provenance.

blocks.title: Research rule
blocks.text: Visual similarity in the atlas is discovery evidence, not semantic identity. Promote a map to a semantic object only with runtime observation or causal evidence.

pages.title: ROM atlas workflow
pages.summary: Export a bounded ROM map range from Graphics Lab or Script API, inspect raw geometry first, then correlate candidates with runtime evidence.

blocks.text: In Graphics Lab > Native Reconstruction Lab, choose Start, End, Format, Palette and Name under ROM Sprite / Vehicle Atlas, then export. Start with raw-pen geometry; palette previews are viewing aids because final palette selection is runtime state.

Script/API action: sprite.rom-atlas.export. The exporter produces per-map PNGs, index/provenance data, labelled browser/contact sheets, a manifest and a ZIP while leaving the live machine state untouched.

items: Use map-number adjacency to spot likely body/accessory/shadow families.
Use source/effective inspection when validating presentation overrides.
Use semantic resolver and checkpoint evidence to distinguish observed maps from ROM-only candidates.
Keep Original as the rendering oracle; atlas decoding is a research/export surface, not a gameplay replacement by itself.

pages.title: RC2.9: confirmed target damage, canonical hit checkpoints and research UX
pages.summary: Consolidates RC2.8 causal discoveries and adds native one-hit target control, SDL pause hotkey, responsive Dashboard controls and longer configurable run timeouts.

blocks.title: Validation boundary
blocks.text: RC2.9 is built from the Windows-proven RC2.8 baseline but requires its own Windows/SDL Build-Debug plus focused RC2.9 regression and Full Regression before promotion.

Target damage is now causally understood: CPU-A 0x1002AE is decremented by PC 0xA112 on a genuine damaging hit. FFFF is the terminal sentinel; underflow from 0000 takes PC 0xA118, writes 0x1002D8=0x1400 and enters the mapped defeat sequence.

items: Preferred target-damage anchor: stage1-target-immediate-pre-damage-6333.chqstate.
Matching post-hit state: stage1-target-first-damage-6334.chqstate.
Contact-only reference pair: frames 5587/5588.
Experimental One-hit Target Kill preserves the authentic A112/A118 code path and defaults OFF.

blocks.text: Dashboard SDL controls sit beside the frame on wide screens and collapse below responsively. Pause/Break toggles pause/resume directly in the SDL window. control.run-frames now accepts a configurable timeout for heavy evidence workloads.

blocks.title: Script query caveat
blocks.text: RC2.9 documents that get*() query functions are preflight-evaluated and cached. If a script changes machine state (for example by loading a checkpoint), a previously preflighted getmaps()/getsprites() iterable can describe the pre-run state. Use `api query.runtime function=...` for explicit execution-time state-sensitive inspection after in-script state changes; existing get* helpers remain preflight-resolved for backward compatibility.

pages.title: Welcome to ChaseHQ-Native
pages.summary: What the project is, how the runtime and Workbench fit together, and where to begin.

blocks.title: Current release
blocks.text: v0.66.9.3 is the current promoted release; direct Windows qualification provenance is 0.66.9.3-RC5 SHA-256 19b7ed48edae98fd99f660ef56a949573050cabc2958fcdba2833a7888103961.

ChaseHQ-Native is both a native Chase H.Q. runtime and an evidence-driven reverse-engineering platform. The SDL window is the live game/render output; the Research Workbench is the browser-based control, inspection, scripting and documentation environment.

blocks.title: Core rule
blocks.text: Gameplay and rendering fidelity are the project. Tooling exists to make behaviour observable, reproducible and provable.

items: Use checkpoints or scenarios to start from known states.
Prefer API/scriptable experiments over one-off UI gestures.
Capture evidence with build, frame, checkpoint and source metadata.
Promote only sufficiently proven findings into authoritative knowledge.

pages.title: Experimental / Game Lab
pages.summary: Reversible Chase H.Q.-specific turbo and speed experiments with API/script parity.

blocks.text: Game Lab groups confirmed gameplay manipulations into named reversible controls. Infinite turbo stock freezes 0x1003A2, infinite active turbo freezes the duration timer at 0x100414, and current speed set/freeze targets the confirmed 32-bit fixed-point field 0x10041C using user speed << 16; Run010 proved the older 16-bit helper could not intercept the 32-bit PC 0x8700 writer.

blocks.title: Current speed is not top-speed limit
blocks.text: 0x10041C is the confirmed current-speed field. The actual maximum-speed clamp/target-speed logic remains an open reverse-engineering task.

api game.turbo.stock enabled=true value=3
api game.turbo.active enabled=true
api game.turbo.fire frames=3
api game.speed.freeze enabled=true value=602
api game.speed.clear

pages.title: v0.66.9.0-RC2 Game Research Controls
pages.summary: Sprite-order A/B diagnostics, corrected sprite-map lookup, and clarified speed semantics.

blocks.text: Game Lab distinguishes HUD display speed at CPU-A 0x100400 (packed BCD) from 32-bit fixed-point internal/physics speed at 0x10041C. The values are not expected to match numerically.

Sprite-order diagnostics preserve legacy names: lower-slot selects descending and higher-slot ascending traversal. First nontransparent candidates reserve pixels, even if layer-masked; names do not describe the winner. Use frame.snapshot.assert-overlap for ownership and export-coordinate assertions.
Turbo HUD animation is confirmed game behavior: active characters 0x0C..0x0F are rewritten from a three-frame source table and cleared at turbo expiry.

pages.title: Safe experiment lifecycle (RC2.5)
pages.summary: Use meaningful headers, known preconditions, try/finally and idempotent timeline.reset so failed experiments do not leak timeline/sprite state.
body: Mutation scripts should never assume the previous run cleaned up successfully. Call timeline.reset before timeline work and again in finally.
Historical timeline state is read-only; use timeline.fork-live before memory writes.
A cleanup failure must not replace the primary experiment failure.
Script Console history defaults to the active session; switch filters explicitly when researching older runs.
examples:
api timeline.reset
try
  api timeline.load name=car-shadow-layer-investigation
  api timeline.seek frame=2352
  api timeline.fork-live
  # experiment
finally
  api timeline.reset
end

pages.title: Trace a memory writer
pages.summary: Find which CPU/PC writes an address or range.

blocks.text: Start from a deterministic checkpoint, enable a bounded write trace, reproduce the state transition, then inspect writer PCs and transaction widths. For byte discovery, width=any avoids missing writes performed by a wider bus transaction.

api checkpoint.load file=stage1-gameplay-2064.chqstate run=false
api memory.trace.clear
api memory.trace.start cpu=A address=0x100303 length=1 width=any limit=256
api control.run-frames count=120
api memory.trace.stop
api memory.trace.tail count=50

api frame.snapshot name=a
api control.run-frames count=30
api frame.snapshot name=b
api image.compare a=a b=b hud=hidden

pages.title: Turbo / HUD investigation
pages.summary: Follow the proven turbo gameplay-to-TC0100SCN HUD path and inspect the active RAM characters directly.

blocks.text: The turbo gameplay/HUD chain is now substantially proven. Activation decrements 0x1003A2 and sets 0x10040F bit 1; the timer 0x100414 expires at 0x00D2. The HUD swaps the consumed slot from normal characters 0x7C..0x7F to active characters 0x0C..0x0F, then clears it at expiry.

include "graphics/turbo-hud-layer-sprite-correlation.chqscript"
include "graphics/turbo-hud-exact-tile-writer-investigation.chqscript"
include "graphics/turbo-hud-text-plane-neighbourhood.chqscript"

include "graphics/turbo-hud-tile-character-inspection.chqscript"

items: Reuse the existing turbo timeline; do not replay gameplay.
Inspect active characters 0x0C..0x0F and normal 0x7C..0x7F with tile.inspect.
Compare raw pens and palette-aware output.
Only reopen compositor/palette hypotheses if the source characters themselves decode correctly but final output remains wrong.

pages.title: Forensic Timeline: record once, investigate repeatedly
pages.summary: Capture a gameplay event once, then import/seek/inspect it through the normal research APIs and fork historical frames back to live execution.

blocks.text: Forensic Timeline v1 stores a deterministic CHQSTATE for every recorded frame and an unfiltered bus-write provenance stream. This intentionally prioritises fidelity and later analysis over storage efficiency.

api timeline.record.start name=turbo-complete-cycle
# run event once
api timeline.record.stop
api timeline.trim.event name=turbo-complete-cycle cpu=A address=0x10040F width=8 mask=02 pre=1 post=1
api timeline.scan.memory name=turbo-complete-cycle

After timeline.load/timeline.seek, the ordinary memory, register, gameplay, sprite and palette inspection APIs operate on the selected historical checkpoint. timeline.fork-live keeps that checkpoint loaded and returns to paused live execution.

blocks.title: Audio limitation
blocks.text: The current native runtime has only sound_stub. Timeline v1 does not claim authentic sound CPU/chip/PCM capture; that capability will be added when native audio emulation exists.

pages.title: TC0100SCN RAM character inspection
pages.summary: Inspect the 256 RAM-backed 8x8 text characters used by the HUD.

blocks.text: api tile.inspect code=0C palette=0 scale=16

The inspector exports a PNG, pen matrix and JSON metadata from character RAM at 0xC06000 + code*16. Pen 0 is transparent; pens 1..3 use the selected palette bank. v1 does not inspect background ROM tiles.

blocks.title: Semantic discipline
blocks.text: The proven 0x10A080-0x10A0BF record may be called CONFIRMED_TARGET_CAR only in explicit Stage-1 checkpoint context; otherwise it remains UNCLASSIFIED_TARGET_RECORD. Raw visible sprites remain UNCLASSIFIED_DYNAMIC_OBJECT; temporal tracks remain UNCLASSIFIED_OBJECT_CANDIDATE. Stable surface candidates use conservative course-record signatures while volatile TC0150 render words remain separate raw evidence. Do not call candidates AI cars, obstacles, asphalt or dirt until separate evidence supports those meanings.

items: Road left/centre/right geometry and the player driven line are separate outputs.
Raw player lateral position/error remains authoritative; the SVG player line is a projection for map visualisation.
Track Recorder v3 reports stable surface candidates/segments separately from raw renderer variants, preventing perspective/scroll changes from masquerading as material changes.

Raw sprite rows are preserved; road-relevant observations receive conservative map/palette/position-based candidate track IDs. Touching rectangles are not merged merely from proximity, and no semantic AI/obstacle promotion is implied.

Object-candidate coverage is fail-closed: every eligible road-region sprite observation must produce one candidate row with map/palette/bounds/position evidence; Track Recorder v3 exposes eligible source rows, candidate rows and coverage (expected 1.0 under the current policy).
Use negative/positive bias surveys only as structural branch coverage; do not relabel candidate A/B as left/right without proof.
Run the 600-frame shakedown before the 3600-frame survey.

pages.title: RC3.4.8: parameter-default parity and failure diagnostics
pages.summary: chqdev qualify --fresh remains the canonical release path; v0.4.1 fixes the Go regression runner parameter-default gap exposed by RC3.4.7 Windows qualification.

blocks.title: Root cause
blocks.text: RC3.4.7 parsed # param frames ... default=4 but compiled the release script with empty variable state, leaving ${frames} unresolved. Manual Workbench focused and Full Regression both passed, proving this was a controller parity defect.

items: Query resolution and compilation now start from script parameter defaults.

Regression failures expose nested error, session ID, run ID, run path and bundle path.

pages.title: RC3.4.9: remove the final Windows CTest exception
pages.summary: The historical cpu_bus_rom_tests SEGFAULT is fixed rather than tolerated; fresh qualification now requires every CTest case to pass.

blocks.title: Proven root causes
blocks.text: Sixteen large stack-local Runtime objects exhausted the Windows test-process stack. Once heap allocated, the test progressed until Windows rejected deletion of files still held open by eight ifstream readers.

items: chqdev qualify --fresh is the canonical fresh Windows promotion command.
Zero tolerated CTest failures; any CTest failure is fatal.
Packages are deterministic and promotion belongs to one exact immutable ZIP SHA.
Focused + Full Regression run against the exact extraction.
PowerShell/BAT release tooling is compatibility/fallback only.
Current human docs, handbook and machine-readable knowledge must stay synchronized.
